title: ArcGIS Pro workflows and connector status
description: Explore ArcGIS Pro workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

SoftwareUpcoming

Esri

ArcGIS Pro

ArcGIS Pro supports professional mapping, spatial analysis and geodatabase workflows.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Build a project map

Start from the approved coordinate reference system and source layers. In the intended ArcGIS Pro preview, build a project map; the visible result is a mapped dataset with the selected geometry and attributes visible. Review location, units, topology and source currency before accepting or exporting it.

Analyse a spatial pattern

Begin with the prepared spatial features and analysis parameters. In the intended ArcGIS Pro preview, analyse a spatial pattern; the visible result is a result layer that exposes the measured pattern or transformation. Review method, edge cases and geographic coverage before accepting or exporting it.

Share a controlled map package

Use the reviewed symbology, labels and metadata. In the intended ArcGIS Pro preview, share a controlled map package; the visible result is a controlled map package with provenance and extent attached. Review legibility, attribution and export settings before accepting or exporting it.
